# Handoffs

The constantly changing session data. What happened, what's open, what the next
session needs.

Rewritten and pushed **every session**, without exception. A handoff that only
exists locally does not exist — that has already cost this project a ten-day-old
CLAUDE.md block that got discarded and three vault handoffs that never reached
GitHub.
